featured_reviews.name: Mukund
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am Mukund, a 23-year-old student currently navigating the high-pressure environment of the United States of America, I have encountered many professionals, but none as unique or dedicated as Astrologer Chintan A Chhayashastri Acharya. What makes Chintan Ji truly stand out, especially to those of us living in the USA who value academic excellence; is that he is a highly educated individual with four vivid degrees.

With his level of education and his fluent English, Chintan Ji could easily command a massive salary in a corporate career, perhaps even here in the USA. However, he has chosen a different path. He has dedicated his life to astrology and the preservation of Indian culture, not as a business, but as a selfless service. It is rare to find someone who chooses spiritual duty over the potential to earn significantly more money elsewhere. This integrity is something I deeply respect as I work toward my own career in the USA.

Being a student in the United States of America is often a struggle of health issues, academic stress, and the fear of the job market. Chintan Ji has been my anchor through it all. He is one of the most exemplary astrologers and Nadi readers in existence today. He listens to every adversity with a caring heart and provides guidance that is both spiritually profound and intellectually sound.

Even with the time difference in the USA, he is incredibly professional and never late for his appointments. He makes time for his clients because he genuinely wants to help, not for financial gain. For anyone in the United States of America seeking a guide who combines the brilliance of a modern scholar with the soul of a traditional healer, Chintan Ji is the finest choice. He is a credit to Indian culture and a blessing to the international community in the USA.

featured_reviews.name: Patricia Giehl
featured_reviews.review_text: I had the pleasure of meeting Chintan 10 years ago when I came to Mumbai from USA for shadow reading.  It was he who brought me to roof of building to measure shadow.  He was very kind, gentle soul.  When it was time for actual reading done by his father, Chintan was also present.  I could sense not only the respect & esteem but also the  love he had for his father.  At that time, Chintan was studying law so that he would be able to expand his help and service to all.   As I understand now, these many years later, Chintan holds four degrees.  Yet, he remains humble and helpful to all as he has chosen to follow and fulfill his lineage of chhayashastra.   Though he is well-educated, he remains simple and loving, working without ego.  It was the best astrology reading I have ever had and continue to take advice from the family to this day.  Their service to humanity is performed from the heart and, profoundly, without avarice.   I highly recommend, to anyone who is a seeking guidance, that you put trust in Chintan and this lineage of shadow readers.   The astrology acumen being what it is, there is sometimes a 2-3 month waiting list.  While you may have to have patience, you will nonetheless be delighted once you are in the presence of the best, receiving meaningful, insightful reading by helpful, loving practitioners of this ancient art.  Chintan is a very simple person suffering no ego of education.
